claims.sourceText: National UFO Historical Records Center, collections page, https://nufohrc.org/collections/, read 2 September 2026
claims.text: The Center states that its records include 'official and civilian case files, audio and video recordings, correspondence, photographs, books, magazines, news clippings, research notes, microfilm, and digital and physical artifacts'. It names no individual artefact, and neither Falcon Lake nor Stephen Michalak appears anywhere on its home, collections or team pages.

claims.sourceText: National UFO Historical Records Center, collections page, https://nufohrc.org/collections/, read 2 September 2026
claims.text: The Center names three collections as its major historical holdings of UFO case files: NICAP, 'founded on October 24, 1956, by inventor Thomas Townsend Brown'; the Center for UFO Studies, which it attributes to J. Allen Hynek in 1973; and 'The Aerial Phenonomena Research Organization (APRO)', started in January 1952 by Jim and Coral Lorenzen and active 'until late 1988'. This is the custodian's own statement of what it holds; no accession record or finding aid is published and none was opened.
